short: Claude Code hook scripts: session/tool-call context injection
is: The Claude Code hook scripts wired in .claude/settings.json (PreToolUse/SessionStart) that inject factual, deterministic context into a session — as distinct from scripts/*.sh, which back `just` dev-loop recipes.
conventions: POSIX sh + jq + awk only — no `sed` (aliased to `sd` on some dev machines), no python3/perl; always exit 0, never fail the event that triggered them.
Injected text is factual statements only, never imperatives — command-shaped injected context can trip prompt-injection defenses.
scripts/hooks/lib.sh's hooks_are_off is the shared kill switch (ZURFUR_HOOKS_OFF containing the hook's name or `all`; an untracked .claude/hooks.off file) sourced by every hook.

scripts/hooks/lib.sh's utf8_safe_head backs a byte truncation off to a valid UTF-8 boundary via `iconv -c` (POSIX-specified, best-effort — falls back to a plain cut if absent); every hard byte cap goes through it, never a bare `head -c`.
Every *.sh here has a *.test.sh beside it; `just hooks-test` runs them all. Test fixtures use jq/awk only, matching the hooks' own runtime dependencies.

fs.name: lib.sh
fs.role: shared hooks_are_off/neutralize/cap_bytes/safe_state_dir/bounded_append helpers, sourced by every hook script
